notes.title: Shards of Her - DEVLog April & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Here we go with another DEVLog, probably the last one before the release of the next update. I'm taking my time to set everything up right and make it seamless for the next ones. I know it takes some time, but I'm trying to deliver a flawless story out there and provide a great experience for everyone.

Now, let's delve into this, and let me present a few things to you, starting from the Prologue up to ACT IV, highlighting the changes and the additional stuff.

PROLOGUE - Veil of Illusion

Some minor changes were made to the dialogue and its visuals. The narrator of the Prologue has been changed, and later in ACT IV we'll find out who it is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/df3d1dede39ebc57f692e3276b782197801134f2.png
Hemera also received some visual updates, reflecting her status back then. Now, later... well, we all know how the story turns out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/27d74f4a9727b612248c9bb364be3955c883333f.png
There are some other changes planned for the Prologue, but those aren't meant to be shown just yet, and they'll only be unlocked after a specific point in the story.

ACT I - Awakening

Now, some story inconsistencies have been fixed, dialogue has been rewritten in some cases, and spellchecks have been done overall. Plus, there are visual changes in some instances, and a new character is introduced towards the end of the ACT.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/0686459275aeb7220d7fdf43c64e0c429da782d0.png
A new scene has been introduced before MC heads to Omikami's Hideout. This character will appear again later in the game, but with a catch. So, right now the scene doesn't hold important meaning for the story, but it will later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8a8d5ca163221de189d5cfe468a742050ba747a7.png
The vision scene between Aethra and Dies has been enhanced, and their conversation has been improved as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/5a7f3157f60566c4ca29f09e89d252ac6b34bbf9.png
Now, towards the end of ACT I, during the narration of a version of War of Shadow, we're introduced to a new character. The whole scene is tied to ACT IV, so I won't say more to avoid spoilers.

ACT II - Echoes

Visually speaking, this ACT wasn't touched much because I already kind of like how it is. However, some changes will be made to it later, especially when MC wakes up and has to choose between calling for Hemera or Omikami, but that's on the TBD list for now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/236a957f05d34c3769aad97fa86b08685442bd40.png
The vision scene has been visually enhanced for both Aethra and MC.

ACT III - Reckoning

This ACT ends, and now we're in the next phase where things are finally starting to get serious, story-wise. Everything starts to connect, linking past, present, and future events, and we finally find out the full story behind Echo's actions and how she was time itself for a while...

New characters make their appearance, and some leave the scene... it's all starting to connect. And the consequences of past events will start to feel real...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/de46ddfeb3b12f853ce442578e94b63b5fe3576a.png
And now, we'll delve into ACT IV... it's up to you to discover what's happening and where the story is going...

Now, regarding the other changes I mentioned before, starting from ACT IV, whenever you discover new things, meet new characters, find new Shards... or when something major happens, they will be added to the CODEX Menu. Let's go over it.

The Shards menu got a little overdone since the last design. I wanted to fully animate the buttons, but even with only two of them unlocked, it started to lag. I guess it's due to the engine, so I left them as static images, but you'll get an animated version of each once you open its page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8365d5c09a8a07f838de866a00d9c1bfe38688fc.png
I don't necessarily consider this a spoiler, but right now two Shards can be found. The rest... well, that's up to you to find. One of them has been in plain sight since the start of the game

As you can see, the page will hold all of the Shards. Each one, as already stated in the game, is based on one of the seven sins and has its own story behind it, explained once you open its page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/68627d2468c12dc42795598c1e8fbb9ef739678b.png
If you've paid attention to the story, you'll notice how each Shard is somehow tied to its current holder, or whoever found it. And how it affected them, or whether it did at all, depends.

Regarding the Timeline, whenever something major happens or has happened and you've just found some new information about it, it'll get updated. For example, the Shards of Her event on the current timeline will be updated in ACT IV because of the things you find out.

And each ACT has its own page which will hold the major events that happened. If an event is too big, it'll have its own section apart from the ACT's own page. As you can see below, we have the section for ACT I - Awakening fully updated. This page, with all that information, only updates once you've finished ACT I; otherwise, you get the initial description without the details of what happened.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/79cd9eecaa15ae92e0c3ae461fcfc0037584b15f.png
You can scroll or drag through it to see everything that has happened as we continue forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/61960699139c0fcafe815f38e666e46bcf762c47.png
As you can see in this image, in the upper right corner, a notification pops up whenever something new is updated or added to the CODEX Menu, so you'll always know. You can check it for more lore information about whatever it is. In the image above, we have the default entry for ACT I - Awakening in the Timeline section of the CODEX Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/6e68d10cc0e50cdb3881c574c17ade223275965e.png
"They survived one Dawn, hoping for peace... They should have prayed the dawn never came again."

The same goes for whenever you meet a new character, find another Shard, or discover a new location; each one comes with its own story.

The STEAM page for the game will be updated once the release is complete and live.

Now, here are the patch notes so far...


 ACT IV Story Content
 Voice Overs for Narration (On-Going)
 Script/Dialogue/Visual Fixes (Overall)
 Story Fixes (Story Inconsistencies)
 New Animations
 New Achievements
 New Intro Screens for ACTs
 Game Conditions Updated
 Notifications for Codex Entries Added (Overall)
 *Persistent Data Values for Characters/Shards/Timeline & Realms


PROLOGUE - Veil of Illusion


 Visual Enhancements
 Small Dialogue and Narration Changes 


ACT I - Awakening


 Visual Enhancements
 Dialogue Fixes & Spellchecking
 New Scenes Added
 Small UI Changes
 NEW Character Introduced


ACT II - Echoes


 Smoothed Transitions
 Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
 Visual Enhancements & Fixes
 Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
 New Small Scene Added (Nakata & MC Scene)


ACT III - Reckoning


 Dialogue Fixes & Small Changes
 Small Story Inconsistencies Fixes
 Smoothed Transitions


* For the moment, this will only be available from the end of ACT III onwards.

I'm sure once again I might have forgotten something to add or reveal, but I'm sure you'll find out once you start playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/8ebb1f14445a595b66c18fae831bb880bc504c92.png
"When the Tempest's fragments sing, and the Reaper begins its harvest... what hope remains? May the gods of creation have mercy, for their world teeters on oblivion."

For this update, I focused mostly on story content, leaving aside additional content that can be added later. I believe focusing on the story is more important.

Also, as mentioned in my previous news post, the DEATH option is now in the game. There will usually be at least one or two options per ACT where our MC has a chance to die. As I said before, you can always reload your save to avoid that.

Lastly, the MEMORIES button is now enabled and accessible. However, content will unlock as you progress through the game. Right now, there's one memory available. Keep in mind that these scenes are meant to be short fragments rather than long or interactive sequences.

With all that said, I hope you'll enjoy the new update and the twists that come later!

notes.title: Shards of Her 0.3.5 - Update PREVIEW
notes.notes:
Hey there! 

I hope all of you are doing great and 2024 is treating you well so far. 

Now, let's get back to business. The next update will advance to version 0.3.5, bringing with it an abundance of new story content and exciting twists for our main character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/3edd2120822b87c8bf26550965e8ffa691d66eed.png

Along with the story content, the Shadow feature will also receive updates. I noticed a portion of Selena's content was also included; this was an oversight from the Christmas update, which I forgot to remove. 
However, this update is not yet complete. Thus, Selena, Neith, and Mikoto will soon join the rest of the characters in the Shadow.

In this update, the main character will embark on a journey to Egypt, where they will finally meet with Selena and Neith. In this segment of the story, Selena, in particular, will play an important role, significantly influencing the game's direction, in some way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/03db3bafd386559df23fcf6ce190dc9696aceecd.png

Starting with this update, the 'Death' feature will be made available. It was initially intended to be accessible from ACT2, but will be reintroduced in the final version of the game.


 This implies that occasionally, you'll encounter choices in the game. Typically, there will be a minimum of three options, and one of these could potentially lead to 'Death'. It's as straightforward as that. Credits will roll reflecting your game's progress, and the ending will vary each time. Don't worry, though – you can always reload from your auto-save and select a different option 


However, in certain instances, you may receive story-related information or catch glimpses of other worlds. Rest assured, I'll integrate these elements gradually to avoid confusion. 
Therefore, feel free to make your choices boldly; you might be amazed by what you discover, though be aware that some choices could lead to your own demise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/4fd11eff6b31cacd1f23c2bd05457a2461b87a5d.png

As we progress through ACT 3, a variety of new characters will be introduced. Some will arrive to assist you, while others may appear bearing warnings. It's important to remember: trust is a complex matter in this narrative. Should you trust anyone, or perhaps not?

As the story unfolds, we will delve deeper into the background of our main character, uncovering the unique qualities that makes him 'special'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a3403f6c599ad27e2bfaaa9e77808f71f1800891.png

I'm trying to avoid revealing too much, as I want to leave the excitement of exploring the next update to you. Unfortunately, I can't provide an ETA for it just yet, but rest assured, I am working on it. As soon as it's ready, I will release it. 
The unexpected delay we encountered has disrupted my schedule somewhat, which is why it's taking me a little longer than usual to compensate and ensure everything is up to standard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a069b367c122cada3a22b1e478c22475ab336035.png

Also, I've reached a small 'milestone' recently. As of now, ACT 3 has officially surpassed ACT 2 in terms of length, image content, and script lines.

NOTE - I avoided from uploading any NSFW images. However, rest assured, there is a significant amount of NSFW material included in the update.

Most likely, I forgot to write something...

notes.title: Shards of Her - 0.3.0 ACT III Update & New UI
notes.notes:
Hey there, 

Let's roll up with the patch notes for the latest update 0.3.0 and the start of ACT III. 

SOH Patch 0.3.0 Notes

Main Game & Additional Content


 ACT III RECKONING Intro
 New UI


Fixes/Bugs and UI Issues


 Fixed some lines where the DEFAULT Name was used instead of the one you choose
 Visual Fixes for ACT I & II


Now, let's explore the NEW UI

First and foremost, I’ve introduced a new menu to the game. It’s in its final version, though still a work in progress, but the core elements are ready for release.

You might notice the "Gods' Summit" button. It’s not yet available because this is a significant modification and is taking a bit more time to perfect. My aim is to have it fully playable by or before the 1.0 release.

Initially, I intended for most of the buttons to be animated, but I’ve encountered some memory issues with RenPy causing significant lag. As a result, for the time being, I’ve opted to use a lite version of the buttons to ensure a smoother user experience.

Upon opening the game, you’ll be greeted with the main menu, from where you can navigate seamlessly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a425231dfd533bb95ce77e5eda81c61b8ab7d6a9.jpg

I've added a 'Continue' button for a more seamless experience; it autoloads your most recent saved game, enabling you to instantly resume your journey. There's also the 'New Journey' option to start afresh, and a special addition, 'Shards of Her'.

This new feature allows you to jump directly into a specific ACT of the game. Here’s a glimpse of how the updated menu looks, this feature is slated for further enhancement during the development process. Eventually, you'll be able to jump directly to specific points within a given ACT.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/09412cb0eaff2e43783d4ae68d2c125f315d2c6a.jpg

At present, you can directly access the Prologue, ACT I, ACT II, and ACT III (locked for now). These options are currently unlocked by default, given the game’s Early Access status. However, upon the release of version 1.0, you will need to complete each ACT sequentially to unlock the next one.

Now, turning our attention back to the Extra menu, a treasury of additional content and features awaits exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/a346f58a9fbb8c1b54a9c867d403309f132b17a5.jpg

At the moment, the options in these menus are already familiar to you. However, keep an eye out as I plan to introduce more features and selections in future updates.

I’ve also revamped the OPTIONS and LEAVE GAME menus. They’re currently in a developmental phase, with the OPTIONS menu, in particular, undergoing further refinements to enhance usability and offer a more intuitive interface.

In this update, the spotlight is cast on the unfolding events of the night where ACT II concluded. I’m introducing core basic changes, redesigned UI, and laying down the narrative groundwork for ACT III.

See you soon with more updates!

Now, regarding the STEAM Cloud support, you might see no saved games if you launch the game after the update, rest assured, they are not lost. Please check this topic in the Discussions section to recover your saves, or just start a new game, it's up to you. 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2442530/discussions/0/3819670593784043136/


Or, here are the steps you need to recover your saves and persistent data. 

[olist]
 Navigate to "C:/Users/USERNAME/AppData/Roaming/RenPy/ShardsofHer-1669473190"
 Copy all the files from this directory.
 Paste them to "SteamApps/common/Shards of Her/game/saves"
 Launch the game. Your files will automatically sync with the Cloud, and you'll be all set.
[/olist]

For any issues, please use the topic from the Discussions section. 

NOTES - Concerning the 0.2.9 update, it will be more substantial as it is intended to provide a conclusion to ACT 2 - Echoes and establish the foundation for ACT 3. The title of ACT 3 will be revealed during Omikami's final speech at the end of 0.2.9 update.

notes.title: Shards of Her - Update 0.2.0 Notes & News
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

I've been working behind the scenes since the last announcement, preparing for the upcoming patches. First and foremost, we'll kick off with version 0.2.0. This major release marks the beginning of ACT II with its initial segment and sets the groundwork for future events.

For the 0.2.0 update, we're introducing the beginning of ACT II along with some fresh features, such as the Shadow Realm. We'll delve deeper into that below. While it will eventually receive its own dedicated announcement, this is its first release.

The patch should go LIVE in less than 24h by the time you're reading this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/26add33824585e9c5e30f2b3b9a75ba13b1f7d49.png

Now, let's start with the notes for 0.2.0 Update. 

Shards of Her 0.2.0 Notes


 ACT II - Echoes Story Content (Start of ACT II)
 SplashScreen updated for ACT II - Echoes
 Main Menu UI Updates
 Game now starts by default in FULL SCREEN
 Launch Teaser can now be skipped by pressing any key
 Additional spellcheck fixes and typography for ACT I
 UI Updates for Characters Menu 
 Characters Menu renamed to "Eternity"
 Timeline was renamed into "Echoes of the Past"
 Music Gallery is now called "The Orchestra"
 Additionally, music from ACT II was added, and now you can change between ACT I and ACT II
 ADDED Shadow Realm (Main Menu > Shadow Realm)


That concludes the 0.2.0 Patch details. More updates will follow. This version lays the foundation for me to add additional content for both the Story and the Shadow Realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/e3f209c0175e38a9dca832e83f56ec89f4b18b6e.png

Now, regarding the Shadow Realm (please note that the UI is very much a work in progress at this stage)

At the moment, Omikami, Nakata, Izanami, and Emma are present in the Shadow Realm. Over time, and as we approach the game's final release, all characters will be included

In this patch, I've included examples of my final design, featuring options to toggle clothes on/off, and various outfits. Some outfits can be discovered in the game and unlocked by meeting specific criteria, while others will be available by default.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/3492a96571bcb1c8545eb7a9b12e8d0409c7f43f.png

In the EARLY ACCESS phase, all characters, outfits, and options will be readily available, given the nature of its early release. However, the 1.0 version will have specific conditions applied where appropriate. The requirements to unlock each outfit are detailed under its respective button, but consider these descriptions as placeholders for now.

That said, I'd greatly appreciate your feedback and suggestions for additional features. The version for Omikami serves as the complete prototype. By "complete," I mean this is the ideal template for all characters in the final product. Each outfit will come with an in/out animation for a close-up view, plus added options where feasible. For instance, in a close-up view of a character's upper body wearing a simple t-shirt, you'd have the option to toggle it on or off.

More outfits and options will be added as the game gradually updates. 

Now, let's return to the main content of the game. In the 0.2.0 update, we kick off ACT II, which will introduce some intriguing events and sensual scenes. 

Later, as the game updates, we'll delve deeper into Emma's background: who designed her, the objectives of her company, and more. While we'll spend a significant amount of time with Nakata, Izanami will only make a comeback towards the end of the ACT. However, in the interim, we'll grow closer to Omikami and encounter some new characters.

So far, my schedule for this version goes like this (keep in mind that it's possible to get a 2 in 1 patch)

 Patch 0.2.0 - Base update for ACT II 
 Patch 0.2.3 - Main Story Content
 Patch 0.2.6 - Main Story Content along with some new characters
 Patch 0.2.9 - Closure for ACT II Story 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/1013e2daccecde429fcd1ec815ac6d2e3d8a48a2.png

These are the primary and most crucial updates slated for version 0.2. Between these, there might be other patches, hotfixes if needed, and added content for the Shadow Realm if it's not included in the main patch.

As always, please share your feedback either here or in the Discussions section. As you can see, I always read them and respond.

The main store page will be updated soon to reflect some of the changes that occurred in this patch.

notes.title: Shards of Her - Patch 0.1.7 & News
notes.notes:
Hey there,

Let's begin with the notes for the latest patch, then we continue with some news! 

SOH Patch 0.1.7 Notes


 ADDED Izanami into the CHARACTERS Showcase.
 ADDED MUSIC ROOM which can be accessed from Main Menu (for ACT 1).
 Script and spellcheck fixes.
 Preparation made for the release of ACT 2.
 Fixed an updated version of AME-MIKOTO not showing up in CHARACTERS.
 Adjustments to TIMELINE Menu (added "BACK" button, previously you had to ESC or RightClick to Exit).
 Default Volume raised up to 0.60 (Before the default was at 0.40, this does not overwrite your own settings).
 Improvements made to the CHARACTERS Showcase. 
 UI changes to the Quit Menu.


As always, please let me know if there are any issues and suggestions are welcomed! 

Now, let's head to some other features that will come in Shards of Her, as additional content for the game and for you. This feature will soon get its own announcement, since it'll be pretty big, and I will share more info then. But, for now, a short summary and what to expect! 

The new feature, or content that will be added it's called God's Summit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181420/961d4fd21ed17184d26607766df16d1ce1e9377e.png

What's God's Summit? 
A new feature which will be available at some time, and you directly access it from the Main Menu of the game, this does not affect nor affected by the main game story and the choices you did. 

So, what can I actually do there?
Talk with the characters you meet along your journey, some may join, some may not! Not everyone is welcomed in the God's Summit, but eventually we'll get there too!

Yes, you can talk with them, but there are other things you can do, like invite one or two of them to some private moments.

So yeah, overall, talk and initiate intimate moments with whatever characters are present at that time in the God's Summit. 

Which characters will be available?
In time yes, at the first release not all of them will be present there, but gradually I'll add most of them. Since it's custom content, there's no limit to what you can do and with whom you want. 

Is there a release date?
There's no ETA yet, I'm working on it, and I'll probably have a release date for it once the announcement is published, which is not that far away. Please keep in mind that not all characters will be present at the time of first release. 


And now, something about the CHARACTERS Showcase

At the moment it seems pretty basic, with characters biography and how they look, but in the feature and along with some other updates this will receive its own updates too. 

Some points or features that will come in the Showcase Menu sooner or later. 

 The featured image of the character will be based on the relationship you have with that character (an ex. if you have a good relationship with Omikami, you'll get a more revealing image of her in the Showcase).
 Different takes, positions and clothes for the Characters (a button will be added for each one of them, taking you into some other dimension where you can play around).

notes.title: Shards of Her - ACT 1 Awakening Release
notes.notes:
Shards of Her - ACT 1 Awakening

Hello there,
